name: University of Vermont Medical Center Program
complement_note: Stated: 'We have a small program with one resident per year' (neurosurgery.aspx landing page, Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2018-39, 2018-09-18) and 'graduates one chief resident a year' (med.uvm.edu/surgery/education/residency, Wayback 2017-09-12). Lateral joiners fill vacated slots (Olszewski and Limoges, both 2015 class by PGY arithmetic, replaced the Li/Strand/Weinberg vacancies; Ng joined the 2022 class).

hosts.to: 2020-08 (residents subpage first captured 2020-08-14; Wayback and Common Crawl have only the landing page 2016-2019)

hosts.url: UVM College of Medicine division pages (uvm.edu/medicine/surgery/?Page=neurosurgery.html 2013-2015; med.uvm.edu/surgery/neurosurgery 2016-2017; uvm.edu/larnermed/surgery/division-neurosurgery live): faculty only, no roster; uvm.edu/medicine/surgery/documents/NeurosurgeryGraduates2.pdf (2015 alumni PDF)

gap_details.2011-2012: Observed: only capture of the gme.fletcherallen.org residents page in the year is Feb 2012 (Ducis = PGY1 2011 entrant, so content-current). 7 residents, one per PGY.
gap_details.2012-2013: No capture of the residents page between 2012-03 and 2014-10 (Wayback exact + prefix on gme.fletcherallen.org; program landing page captures 2012-08..2013-06 carry no names; fletcherallen.org neurological_care residency page and UVM surgery division page carry no residents; UVM Surgery Annual Report 2012 PDF lists the 2011-12 residents only; Common Crawl 2012-2015-14 has only the landing page, CC-MAIN-2012 not queryable). Reconstructed 7: Gibbons 7, Murray 6, Stockwell 5, Tsen 4, Lin 3, Ducis 2, Akture 1 (Akture alumni-confirmed 2019). Complete for a 1/yr program unless an unseen person left. PHASE 2: CC-MAIN-2012 (old index format) still not queryable with cclocal.
gap_details.2013-2014: Same as 2012-13 (no capture). Reconstructed 6: Murray 7, Stockwell 6, Tsen 5, Lin 4, Ducis 3, Akture 2. PGY-1 slot is almost certainly Xun Li (PGY2 in 2014-15) but he is not bracketed nor an alumnus, so not reconstructed.
gap_details.2015-2016: Observed Dec 2015 on gme.uvmhealth.org (same to Mar 2016). 7, new intern James Weinberg.
gap_details.2016-2017: SIGNIFICANT. From 2016-04 the program moved to uvmhealth.org/gme/Pages/Residencies/neurosurgery.aspx; its 'Our Residents' subpage (neurosurgery-residents.aspx) has no Wayback capture before 2020-08-14 and no Common Crawl record 2015-2020 (only the landing page, Feb/Jun 2018). med.uvm.edu/surgery/neurosurgery (2016-17) lists faculty only. Reconstructed partial: Lin 7, Ducis 6, Akture 5, Muse 1 (alumni-confirmed). Li, Strand, Weinberg left somewhere in 2016-2020; Olszewski/Limoges arrived somewhere in 2016-2020. PHASE 2: Akture now OBSERVED as 'visiting housestaff from University of Vermont (PGY-5 year)' on Utah's current-residents page (Wayback 2016-11-03; separate 'other' capture). Strand reconstructed PGY3: World Neurosurg paper received 2017-04 with 'Division of Neurosurgery, University of Vermont College of Medicine' (PMID 28962963). Retried CC-MAIN-2017-04: 0 records.
gap_details.2017-2018: SIGNIFICANT, as 2016-17. Reconstructed partial: Ducis 7, Akture 6, Muse 2, Thakrar 1. PHASE 2: Utah's 2017-18 roster (Wayback 2017-11-15, unchanged 2017-07..2018-03) lists only Utah's own PGY5s (Brock, Karsy) and no UVM visitor, although UVM PGY5s were at Utah in 2014-17 and 2019-21 -> the 2013-class PGY5 slot (Xun Li) was vacant, consistent with Li having transferred to Brown (Brown PGY4 2017-18 by arithmetic).
gap_details.2018-2019: SIGNIFICANT, as 2016-17. Reconstructed partial: Akture 7, Muse 3, Thakrar 2, Silveira 1. PHASE 2: Olszewski reconstructed PGY4: 'Division of Neurosurgery, University of Vermont Medical Center' on Curr Opin Pediatr Dec 2018 (PMID 30407974). Utah 2018-19 roster unobserved (301s), so the UVM visitor that year is unknown. CC-MAIN-2018-39 retried: only the landing page (no names; states 'one resident per year').
gap_details.2019-2020: SIGNIFICANT, as 2016-17. Reconstructed partial: Muse 4, Thakrar 3, Silveira 2. Erin D'Agostino (PGY2 2020-21, 2019 entrant) not reconstructed (not alumni-confirmed). The Aug 2020 .aspx capture is identical to Sep 2020 and is 2020-21 content (Adams intern). PHASE 2: Limoges OBSERVED as 'visiting resident from University of Vermont (PGY-5 year)' on Utah's roster (Wayback 2019-10-14). Olszewski reconstructed PGY5 (bracketed by the Dec-2018 paper and the 2020-21 roster). D'Agostino reconstructed PGY1: UVM neurosurgery affiliation on papers received 2019-06 (PMID 31295604) and 2019-11 (PMID 32197250). CC-MAIN-2019-51 retried: 0 records.
gap_details.2020-2021: Observed Sep 2020 (same Aug 2020-Jun 2021). 7; no PGY7 (the 2014 entrant Strand is gone); two PGY6 (Olszewski, Limoges).
gap_details.2022-2023: Observed Mar 2023. The Dec 2022 capture was half-updated (Callahan/Zerebiec advanced; D'Agostino still PGY3, Adams PGY2, no PGY4); the Mar 2023 version advanced everyone consistently and was used. 7.
gap_details.2023-2024: Observed Sep 2023 (same to Jun 2024). 7; D'Agostino gone; Christina Ng new at PGY2.
gap_details.2024-2025: Observed Nov 2024 (same to Sep 2025). 6; no intern and no PGY6 listed (2018 class = Silveira was PGY7; 2019 class D'Agostino left). Craig Methot, PGY2 in 2025-26, is not on this page: either a 2024 intern omitted from the page or a PGY2 joiner in 2025.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live 2026-09-27, advanced vs 2025-26 with new intern McNamee. 8.

departures.name: Xun Li
departures.note: 2013 entrant (Temple MD). TRANSFERRED to Brown/Rhode Island Hospital (program 54): Brown roster 2018-19 lists Xun Li PGY5 with Temple MD (same person); Brown alumnus 2021 (one-year setback). Left UVM after 2015-16 (PGY3) or 2016-17: Utah's 2017-18 roster has no UVM visiting PGY5, i.e. his slot was vacant by 2017-18. Recorded in training_history (transferred, end_year 2017 = latest possible).

departures.name: Adam Strand
departures.note: 2014 entrant (Georgetown). Still in UVM Division of Neurosurgery in Apr 2017 (PMID 28962963, PGY3 2016-17). Gone by 2020-21; not an alumnus. Left mid-2017..mid-2020, outcome UNKNOWN. Phase-1 'internal medicine' was a wrong-person NPPES match: Adam Orville Strand was an internal-medicine resident at Wright State in 2015 (PMID 26464407) while this Strand was a UVM PGY2. Another NPPES Adam Strand (emergency medicine, IA, enumerated 2014-04) is a name match only.

departures.name: James Weinberg
departures.note: 2015 intern (Univ. of South Carolina); 'James D Weinberg, College of Medicine, UVM' on a May 2016 paper (PMID 27148848). Left mid-2016..mid-2020, outcome UNKNOWN. NPPES James David Weinberg MD (FL, enumerated 2015, anesthesiology/pain) is plausible but name-only, so no specialty switch recorded.

departures.name: Erin D'Agostino
departures.note: 2019 entrant (Geisel). Last roster PGY4 2022-23. SWITCHED SPECIALTY to neurology at UVM: 'Resident Physician, Neurology Department, University of Vermont Medical Center' (Emerg Med Pract 2025, PMID 39836567). Recorded in training_history (switched_specialty, end_year 2023).

joiners.name: Christina Ng
joiners.note: 2022-23 roster observed and lacks her; now PGY5 with the 2022 class. NYMC MD (publications as NYMC student through 2023); no prior neurosurgery roster in the DB, so probably a preliminary year before joining at PGY2.

joiners.name: Craig Methot
joiners.note: 2024-25 roster observed (stale to Sep 2025) and lacks him, but that page listed no intern at all, so he may have been an unlisted 2024 intern.

joiners.name: Adam Olszewski
joiners.note: Jefferson MD; NPI enumerated 2015-04 (2015 intern somewhere else: absent from UVM's observed 2015-16 roster). At UVM by 2018-19 (Division of Neurosurgery affiliation, Curr Opin Pediatr Dec 2018). Joined above PGY-1 in 2016-17, 2017-18 or 2018-19; origin program not found (not on any roster in the DB). Graduated UVM 2022.

joiners.name: Natalie Limoges
joiners.note: DO, Western University COMP-NW (maiden name Winn per NPPES other-name); NPI enumerated 2015-01 (2015 intern elsewhere). At UVM by 2019-20 (UVM visiting PGY5 on Utah's roster; UVM paper received 2019-11). Joined above PGY-1 in 2016-17..2019-20; origin program not found (no pre-2019 publications under Limoges or Winn). Graduated UVM 2022.

adjudication_summary.caveats: Li = transfer to Brown (training_history). Strand and Weinberg = outcome unknown (training_history completed='unknown' overrides wrong/name-only NPPES switch calls). D'Agostino = switched to neurology (publication affiliation).

problems: The UVM residents subpage was never archived 2016-04..2020-08 in Wayback or Common Crawl (all crawls incl. retried 2017-04, 2018-39, 2019-51). 2016-17..2018-19 remain partial reconstructions (significant); 2019-20 is nearly complete (low). CC-MAIN-2012 old format not queryable. OpenAlex returned 429 (shared IP), so Europe PMC and PubMed were used instead. Brown (program 54) should add Xun Li's transfer-in row (joined 2016-17 or 2017-18) on its side. The Common Crawl scan of the UVM Surgery hosts (2016-2020) was stopped after about 144 of 162 crawl/prefix pairs; the unfinished pairs are the late-2020 crawls, after the gap.
